answer_1.quote: This paper proposes a semantic frame forecast task that aims to forecast the semantic frames in the next 10, 100, or even 1,000 sentences of a story.

answer_2.quote: We use Cosine Similarity between the predicted vector and the gold-standard vector (complied from the human-written story block) for evaluation.

answer_4.quote: We further evaluate the proposed method with humans. We first visualize the vector of semantic frames into word clouds so that humans can perceive and comprehend it. We then use online crowd workers to test the (i) representativeness and (ii) the specificity of the produced word clouds.
answer_4.guideline: Workers are asked to read the story and select the word cloud that better represents the story block.
